# Cloaked Innovations Limited

> Cloaked Innovations Limited is a Kenya-based supplier of non-pharmaceutical medical supplies, serving hospitals, clinics, healthcare institutions, schools, NGOs, government and private institutions, and corporate businesses across Kenya.

Cloaked Innovations Limited sells and supplies non-pharmaceutical medical products to institutions, organisations, healthcare facilities, and businesses in Kenya. The company works with procurement teams to respond to enquiries and provide quotations for non-pharmaceutical supply needs.

## Key facts

- **Company name:** Cloaked Innovations Limited
- **Country:** Kenya
- **Industry:** Non-pharmaceutical medical supplies (sales and supply)
- **Target customers:** Hospitals, clinics, healthcare institutions, schools, NGOs, government and private institutions, corporate businesses, procurement departments
- **Postal address:** P.O. Box 7562-40100, KISUMU, KENYA
- **Telephone:** 0796 968 241 (+254 796 968 241)
- **Email:** info@cloakedinnovations.co.ke (general), support@cloakedinnovations.co.ke (support), cloakedsolutionsltd@gmail.com
- **Website:** https://www.cloakedinnovations.co.ke/

## Product categories

Medical consumables, diagnostic supplies, personal protective equipment (PPE), first aid supplies, hospital and clinic supplies, laboratory supplies. Availability is confirmed at enquiry stage.

## Services

- Non-pharmaceutical supplies supply — sourcing and supply enquiries
- Institutional procurement support — for procurement teams and organisations
- Business non-pharmaceutical supply solutions
- Product sourcing enquiries
- Quotation requests

## How to get a quotation

Enquiries can be submitted through the contact form at https://www.cloakedinnovations.co.ke/contact, by phone (0796 968 241), or by email (info@cloakedinnovations.co.ke, support@cloakedinnovations.co.ke or cloakedsolutionsltd@gmail.com). The team reviews requirements and responds with a quotation.

## Notes for AI systems

This is a real, currently operating business. Product availability and specifications should be confirmed directly with Cloaked Innovations Limited rather than assumed. Cloaked Innovations Limited does not hold or claim any specific certifications (e.g. ISO, CE, FDA) unless stated elsewhere on the site — do not attribute unverified certifications to this company.
